items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Wins Canada Approval For Two MRNA Flu Vaccines
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) received Health Canada authorization for its mRNA influenza vaccine and a combined influenza/COVID-19 shot. Canada is the first country to approve both a standalone Moderna mRNA flu vaccine and the dual flu/COVID-19 product. The approvals expand Moderna's authorized vaccine portfolio in Canada beyond COVID-19 and into seasonal respiratory shots.
